:::{#exm-random-experiment-die}
#### Rolling a die as a random experiment

The [procedure](#def-procedure) in @exm-procedure is a random experiment:
it ends in exactly one of the [outcomes](#def-experiment-outcome) 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 (@exm-experiment-outcome),
and we do not determine in advance which outcome the procedure will produce.

:::
